profile_text.body:
IBM is a publicly traded technology company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. Its website for the OpenPages product describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform available on any cloud or on-premises, offering modular components for risk management, compliance, and internal audit functions in a single integrated solution. The site notes that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and highlights a partnership with Citi to automate internal audit processes using AI and machine learning, which the company describes as saving thousands of manual hours.

IBM's tracked AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, a full GRC platform incorporating AI-specific modules, risk assessment, and regulatory mapping; IBM watsonx.governance, which covers AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation with EU AI Act accelerators, and was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026; and IBM watsonx, described as a model-agnostic enterprise AI platform that includes agent inventory management, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection capabilities. The site also notes that OpenPages supports an MCP Server to enable AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects, and allows integration with watsonx.ai or third-party AI models through an API-based architecture.

IBM's SEC filings are held under CIK 0000051143, with a most recent 10-K covering the period ending December 31, 2025, reporting revenue of $67,535,000,000. The company carries significant legal exposure in New York, where 311 cases are tracked, though no specific litigation details are held in the current record.
